### Style summary

- **Naming** — consuming builders are `with_*(mut self, …) -> Self` throughout (`Target` ×18, `CbmcGrow` ×10, `GenCanPack` ×6 GENCAN-only plus `with_restart`, `PackEngine` ×13 provided, `LatticeConfig`/`LatticeGrow`, `Pipeline`). Seam implementors carry the seam suffix — `GencanStage`, `GrowStage`, `LatticeStage`, plus `Repeat`/`Guarded` — while preset entries are bare nouns (`GenCanPack`, `CbmcGrow`, `LatticeGrow`). Each stage owns a `pub(crate) const NAME: &'static str` (`"gencan"` / `"growth"` / `"lattice"`) returned by `Stage::name`. Frozen public outcome is `State`; live run object is `PackState`; borrowed telemetry is `context::RuntimeState` — three types, one lifecycle, no alias either way. Continuation of free placements is `GenCanPack::with_restart`; obstacle chaining is `Target::fixed_from`. Restraints `*Restraint`, regions `*Region`, PyO3 wrappers `Py*` in Rust and unprefixed via `#[pyclass(name = …)]` (`PyState` → Python `State`). No `packmol` identifier anywhere (prose only).
- **Construction / errors** — one crate error `PackError` (17 variants), predominantly struct-like with `&'static str` payloads (`StageOrder { stage, needs }`, `PresetSettingsInsidePipeline { stage, knob }`, `InvariantViolated { stage, invariant, layer, atoms }`, `SeedMismatch { expected, got }`), and `Display` bodies that name the offender and the remedy. `GrowError` is the growth leaf error, wrapped as `PackError::Grow`; `ScriptError` is the separate front end. `#[non_exhaustive]` on `StepInfo`, `Requires`, `Guarantees`, `StageOutcome`, `Budget`, each with a `new` constructor. `Stage::run -> Result<StageOutcome, PackError>` is fallible by design: a stage fails by a named error, never by `converged = false`; the verdict (`fdist`/`frest`) is read off the state by the pipeline, never self-reported. `PackEngine::run` returns `Result<State, PackError>` and is required (no provided body) so there is exactly one lifecycle (`Pipeline`).
- **Tests** — integration tests in `tests/`, one file per subsystem; in-crate `#[cfg(test)]` where `pub(crate)` forces it (`src/context/pack_state/tests.rs`, `src/entry/result.rs`). Bitwise continuity goldens in `tests/pipeline.rs` / `tests/grow.rs` compare pipelines to `GenCanPack::with_restart`. Python: `python/tests/test_state.py` owns the `State` pyclass; `test_entry.py` asserts no `PackResult` / no `seeded_from`.
- **Gates** — fast tier `cargo test -p molcrafts-molpack --lib --tests`; release Packmol regression `--release --features io --test examples_batch -- --ignored`; Python `tox -c python -e py` (the `uv run --directory python --group dev tox -e py` spelling is blocked by debt D-04).
- **Feature gates** — `default = []` on the library; the wheel sets `default = ["ff"]` and builds without `io`. `ff` gates `src/optimizer/` and `GenCanPack::with_optimizer` only.
- **Docs-as-code** — `docs/{getting_started,concepts,architecture,extending}.md` are `include_str!`-mounted as empty rustdoc modules (`src/lib.rs:189-199`).

### Layer roles

- `src/script/` — **front end**. `parser` depends on `error` only; `build.rs` lowers an `.inp` onto `GenCanPack` + `Target` + `PackEngine` + restraints. Nothing in the packing lifecycle depends on it but `bin/` and `python/src/script.rs`.
- `src/target.rs` — **specification layer**. Depends on `restraint`, `frame`, `entry` (`fixed_from(&State)`).
- `src/entry/` — **shared settings + space + frozen result**. Depends on `context`, `error`, `handler`, `restraint`, `target`. Names neither `pipeline` nor `stage`. Owns `State` (freeze point) and hidden `Placements` (the seed `with_restart` reads).
- `src/pipeline/` — **lifecycle owner** (the only `PackEngine::run` in the crate). Assembles `State` after the last stage; does not return a live `PackState`. Names no algorithm module.
- `src/stage.rs` — **the seam**. Depends on `context`, `error`, `handler`, `target`. No `ff`, no algorithm module.
- `src/gencan/`, `src/grow/`, `src/grow/lattice/` — **algorithm peers**, each with one `*Stage` on the seam and one preset entry via `Pipeline::single`. Neither names the other. Cross-algorithm hand-off is caller-side (`Pipeline::with_stage` or `GenCanPack::with_restart`).
- `src/invariant.rs` — **guard leaf**; depends on `context` only (`PackState`).
- `src/template.rs` — **pure leaf**; `std` + molrs `Frame` only. Bond graphs are `molrs::Topology`.
- `src/context/`, `src/objective.rs`, `src/constraints/`, `src/restraint/`, `src/region.rs` — **shared bottom layer**.
- `src/error.rs` — no upward edge to `pipeline`/`stage`, but see the `error → grow` edge below.
- `src/initial.rs`, `src/movebad.rs` — **GENCAN-path machinery** at crate root; `install_resolved_cell` is also called by grow.
- `src/euler.rs`, `src/numerics.rs`, `src/random.rs`, `src/frame.rs` — leaf utilities; `src/assemble.rs`, `src/handler.rs`, `src/validation.rs` — cross-cutting.
- `src/optimizer/` — **`ff`-gated add-on**, reached only from `gencan/`.
- `src/bin/molpack/` — **CLI front end** (`cli`).
- `python/src/` — **binding layer**. `PyState` wraps crate `State`; `with_restart` is bound on `PyGenCanPack` only.

**Known cycles / debts** — `initial ↔ gencan`; `initial ↔ movebad`; `movebad ↔ gencan`; `objective ↔ constraints`; `region ↔ restraint`; `target ↔ entry` (`fixed_from(&crate::entry::State)`); `context ↔ frame`; `handler ↔ stage`. Non-cycle layer break: `error → grow`. Open debts in `.claude/notes/notes.md`: **D-01** growth hard-core unreachable at melt density (partial local fix landed; rest owed to `grow-axes`), **D-02** two derivations of the grid `radmax` coverage radius (spellings unified onto `radius_ini`; coverage `R` vs `2R` still split), **D-04** the `uv … tox` spelling cannot resolve (molrs double pin), **D-05** `initial()` still speaks flat slices and bridges through a temporary `RigidView` twice. **D-03 cleared** 2026-09-03.

## Lifecycle (custom annotation, kept across /mol:map runs)

```
.inp script ──parser──▶ Script ──build──▶ Targets ──Pipeline::run (PackEngine)──▶ State
                                            presets: GenCanPack / CbmcGrow / LatticeGrow
                                                     = Pipeline::single(entry)
                                                     │
                                                     └─ Stage seam ─▶ gencan/ | grow/ | grow/lattice/   (peers)
                                                        combinators: Repeat / Guarded (pipeline/combinators.rs)
                                                        guards:      Invariant / Layers (invariant.rs)
                                                        shared:      context/ (PackState, RigidView), objective,
                                                                     constraints/, restraint/, region, template
```

Landed 2026-09-03 (`stage-pipeline` chain 01–07): the seam is `Stage` (fallible
`run`), `Pipeline` owns the one lifecycle, presets are `StageFactory`s, and the
Python wheel mirrors `Pipeline` through a per-entry `IntoStageFactory` + one
registry. Still planned (specs `dg-refine` / `grow-axes`): `refine/` joins
`gencan/` and `grow/` as a third peer (first consumer of `Repeat`/`Guarded`),
and growth collapses to one `Grow<Space, ExcludedVolume>` driver with the
entries as presets.
